name: Arm circles
cues: Start with small circles, then let them grow. | Shoulders stay down. | Keep breathing.

name: Wall slides
cues: Back of the hands and elbows try to touch the wall. | Slide up only as far as the ribs stay down. | Don't shrug.

name: Incline walk primer, easy pace
cues: Easy pace. This is only to get warm. | Hold the rails lightly. | Stay tall.

name: Incline DB press (30°)
cues: Set the bench near 30 degrees. | Wrists stay stacked over the elbows. | Press up and slightly in.

name: Cable lateral raise (low pulley)
cues: Lead with the elbow, not the hand. | Stop around shoulder height. | Keep the shoulder down, away from the ear.

name: Seated cable chest press
cues: Pin the shoulder blades to the pad. | Press until the elbows are almost straight. | Keep the handles at chest height.

name: Front plank
cues: Ribs down, glutes tight. | Push the floor away so the upper back stays broad. | Straight line from head to heels.

name: Face pull (rope, high)
cues: Pull the rope toward your face. | Finish with thumbs back and shoulder blades together. | Ribs down so the low back doesn't arch.

name: Dead bug
cues: Low back stays lightly pressed down. | Exhale as the arm and opposite leg reach. | Slow enough that the pelvis doesn't rock.

name: Cable fly, high-to-low
cues: Keep a soft bend in the elbows. | Sweep down and in, like hugging a barrel. | Squeeze the chest. Don't crash the handles.

name: Overhead rope triceps extension
cues: Elbows point forward and stay narrow. | Only the forearms move. | Stretch at the bottom, lock out at the top.

name: Triceps pushdown
cues: Elbows pinned to your sides. | Straighten the arms fully. | Control the way up.

name: Incline walk, 10–14° at 2.8–3.3 mph
cues: Hold the rails lightly. Don't hang. | Short stride, land mid-foot. | Stay tall. Don't lean on the console.

name: Doorway pec stretch
cues: Forearm on the frame, elbow near shoulder height. | Step through until the chest opens. | Breathe. Don't bounce.

name: Triceps stretch behind the head
cues: Elbow points at the ceiling. | Gentle pull. Stop before the shoulder pinches. | Ribs stay down.

name: Chest opener, hands clasped behind
cues: Clasp the hands behind you or hold a rack. | Lift the chest and squeeze the shoulder blades. | Stop if the front of the shoulder pinches.

name: Scapular squeezes
cues: Pinch the shoulder blades down and back. | Don't shrug toward the ears. | Hold one second, then release.

name: Lat pulldown (high pulley)
cues: Lean back just a little. | Pull the bar to the upper chest. | Drive the elbows toward your hips.

name: Chest-supported DB row
cues: Chest stays on the pad. | Pull the elbows back, not out wide. | Pause when the shoulder blades squeeze.

name: Kneeling cable crunch
cues: Hips stay stacked over the knees. | Round the spine. Don't just hinge at the hips. | Exhale hard at the bottom.

name: Standing DB calf raise
cues: Pause at the top on the balls of the feet. | Lower until you feel a calf stretch. | Knees stay soft, not locked.

name: Seated cable row (V-handle)
cues: Sit tall. Don't swing the torso. | Pull the handle to the lower ribs. | Shoulder blades back and down.

name: Incline DB curl
cues: Upper arms stay pointing at the floor. | Curl without the shoulders rolling forward. | Lower until the biceps stretch.

name: Cable lateral raise
cues: Lead with the elbow, not the hand. | Stop around shoulder height. | Keep the shoulder down, away from the ear.

name: Hammer curl
cues: Thumbs stay up. | Elbows stay beside the ribs. | Don't rock the hips to start the weight.

name: Hollow hold
cues: Low back pressed flat. | Ribs down, arms and legs long. | If the back peels up, bend the knees.

name: Side plank
cues: Bottom elbow under the shoulder. | Hips stacked. Don't let the top hip roll back. | Push the floor away.

name: Lat stretch, arm overhead
cues: Reach long, then lean slightly away. | Stop at a stretch along the side of the back. | Don't shrug the shoulder to the ear.

name: Biceps stretch, arm on a wall
cues: Arm straight, palm on the wall. | Turn the body away until the biceps pull. | Keep the elbow soft if the front of the shoulder bites.

name: Leg swings, front to back
cues: Hold a rack for balance. | Swing under control. Don't yank the hip. | Stay tall on the standing leg.

name: Bodyweight squat primer
cues: Sit the hips back and down. | Knees track over the mid-foot. | Easy reps. Stop above any knee pinch.

name: Glute bridges, easy
cues: Drive through the heels. | Squeeze the glutes at the top. | Ribs stay down.

name: DB Romanian deadlift
cues: Soft knees, hinge at the hips. | Dumbbells stay close to the legs. | Stop when the hamstrings pull, then stand tall.

name: Pallof press (cable, mid)
cues: Stand side-on, feet about hip width. | Press straight out and don't let the cable twist you. | Ribs stacked over the pelvis.

name: Leg extension (3 s down, pain-free)
cues: Pad sits just above the ankles. | Three seconds down, only a pain-free range. | Don't slam the knees straight.

name: Seated leg curl
cues: Pad on the lower calves. | Curl the heels toward the glutes. | Hips stay on the seat.

name: Hip thrust (DB or barbell)
cues: Upper back on the bench, chin tucked. | Drive through the heels. | Squeeze the glutes at the top, ribs down.

name: Reverse crunch on bench
cues: Lift the hips, not just the knees. | Low back stays down. | Lower with control.

name: Hip flexor stretch, half kneel
cues: Back knee down, pelvis tucked. | Squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg. | Tall chest. Don't arch the low back.

name: Hamstring stretch, one leg long
cues: Hinge from the hips, back long. | Stop at a strong pull, not a stab. | Don't bounce.

name: Calf stretch on a step
cues: Heel drops, knee straight. | Then soften the knee for a second stretch. | Hold. Don't bounce.

name: Flat DB press
cues: Feet planted. | Lower until the dumbbells are beside the chest. | Elbows about 45 degrees from your sides.

name: Single-arm cable row (mid)
cues: Brace so the cable doesn't twist you. | Pull the elbow past the ribs. | Reach long on the way back.

name: Seated DB shoulder press
cues: Start with the dumbbells at ear height. | Press up without shrugging. | Don't bang the weights together.

name: Neutral-grip lat pulldown
cues: Palms face each other. | Pull the elbows down toward the pockets. | Chest stays up.

name: Reverse crunch
cues: Lift the hips, not just the knees. | Low back stays down. | Lower with control.

name: Reverse cable fly (high)
cues: Soft elbows, arms almost straight. | Sweep wide until the hands line up with the shoulders. | Squeeze the rear delts. Don't shrug.

name: Cable curl
cues: Elbows pinned in front of the hips. | Curl the bar. Don't lean back. | Lower until the elbows are straight.

name: Rope pushdown
cues: Split the rope at the bottom. | Elbows glued to your sides. | Lock out, then come back under control.

name: Cable woodchop (high to low)
cues: Pivot the back foot. | Arms stay long. Rotate from the trunk. | Finish with the hands near the opposite hip.

name: DB curl
cues: Elbows stay under the shoulders. | Palms up. No hip swing. | Lower until the elbows are straight.

name: DB skull crusher
cues: Upper arms stay vertical. | Lower the dumbbells beside the head, not onto it. | Elbows point at the ceiling.

name: Joint circles, easy range
cues: Move one joint at a time through an easy range. | Ankles, hips, then shoulders. | Nothing should sting. Shrink the circle if it does.

name: Bodyweight box squats, empty bar x10, light sets
cues: Sit back to the box. Don't drop. | Knees track over the mid-foot. | Stand by pushing the floor away.

name: Barbell box squat (box at or above parallel)
cues: Box at or above parallel. | Brace before you unrack. | Touch the box lightly, then stand.

name: Leg extension
cues: Pad sits just above the ankles. | Squeeze the quads at the top. | Don't slam the knees straight.

name: Band lying leg curl
cues: Hips stay down. | Curl the heels toward the glutes. | Control the band on the way back.

name: Cable pull-through (rope)
cues: Face away, rope between the legs. | Hinge, then squeeze the glutes to stand. | Arms stay straight. This is a hip move.

name: Seated calf raise (DB on knees)
cues: Dumbbells rest on the knees. | Full stretch at the bottom. | Pause at the top.

name: Pallof press
cues: Stand side-on, feet about hip width. | Press straight out and don't let the cable twist you. | Ribs stacked over the pelvis.

name: Easy march in place
cues: Lift the knees only as high as is easy. | Arms swing naturally. | Quiet feet.
